attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: চাকরি বা পরিচয়ে একজনকে যে নামে চেনা যায়, সেই নামই তার designation।

definition.oewn_definition: identifying word or words by which someone or something is called and classified or distinguished from others
definition.text: identifying word or words by which someone or something is called and classified or distinguished from others

examples.bn: ফর্মে তার পদবি লেখা আছে হিসাবরক্ষণ কর্মকর্তা।
examples.en: Her designation on the form is accounts officer.
